prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Nihonium (Nh) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a riverside seating area waiting for festival fireworks
Time of day: night under neon and signage light, coloured reflections.
Small moment: a small glitter sticker sparkles on her cheek.
Outfit: a one-shoulder goddess gown of flowing chiffon gathered at one shoulder with a gold brooch, the other shoulder and arm bare, a thigh-high slit — in soft dove grey; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 60-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 40-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body facing the camera; head facing the camera straight on, both ears about equally visible; camera slightly below, looking up at her; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand makes a V sign beside her face.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: heavy-lidded eyes, lips slightly parted and relaxed, brow smooth.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — nihonium: a synthetic superheavy element, the first ever discovered and named in the far east of the world, named for the land of the rising sun; a team at an eastern research institute fired zinc ions at a bismuth target day and night for nine years, from 2004 to 2012, and caught only three atoms in all; a century earlier a chemist from the same land had announced a new element under a similar name that was struck from the tables, and what he had really found turned out to be another element, so the name came back after a hundred years; it sits below thallium and is predicted to be a heavy, soft metal, but its atoms last only seconds — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: statuesque, long-legged, with a natural neck length — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.
